question: The SI unit of acceleration is ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __m/s2__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The international System of Units (SI), commonly known as the metric system, is the international standard for measurement.
 
• We can drive units of other quantities by using fundamental units:
 
• *velocity = Velocity is defined as the rate of change in distance *
 
• *unit of velocity = unit of length/unit of time = metre/sec*
 
• *Acceleration = rate of change of the velocity *
 
• Unit of acceleration = unit of velocity/ unit of time = metre/sec/sec = metre/sec2
